prompt:
A high-fidelity flat UI design mockup of a desktop web application screen, rendered straight-on with no perspective, no device frame, no hands, no room. This is a screen design, not a photograph or poster.

LAYOUT SKELETON, top to bottom, stated literally, as two stacked registers:

1. A full-width horizontal navigation beam, 56px tall, solid near-black carbon (#17161a). At its left the wordmark "PLIA" in condensed uppercase sans, beside it three small uppercase labels "TABLEAU DE BORD", "TRANSACTIONS", "HISTORIQUE" with the last underlined by a 2px red rule. At its right two thin line icons and a circular avatar initial.

2. FIRST REGISTER, directly under the beam, occupying the top third: a full-width band on a dark carbon plate (#17161a) with 45-degree cut corners, headed at its left by a small uppercase letterspaced monospace label "OÙ TU ATTERRIS". Inside it, three wide month columns side by side, separated by 1px hairlines in a lighter carbon. Each column holds the month name in large condensed sans in off-white ("JUILLET", "AOÛT", "SEPTEMBRE") with the year in small monospace, and beneath it three stacked figures, each a tiny uppercase monospace label above a large monospace amount: "RÉEL 1 830,20 €", "PRÉVU 2 813,00 €", "SI DÉPASSEMENT −240,50 €" with the negative one in signal red. The third month carries a tiny uppercase monospace tag "PROJECTION".

3. SECOND REGISTER, below it, occupying the bottom two thirds: the working grid on a light plate (#eeece8) with 45-degree cut corners, headed at its left by a small uppercase letterspaced monospace label "COMMENT TU Y VAS". Its structure: a wide left spine column of expense category names in condensed sans ("Salaire", "Loyer", "Assurance", "Courses", "Essence", "Sorties", "Abonnements", "Vacances"), each with a small chevron and a tiny uppercase letterspaced monospace duration label. To its right, THREE month blocks separated by a strong 1px vertical hairline and a wide gutter, each headed by the month name in condensed sans and only THREE tiny uppercase monospace column labels: "BUDGET  DÉPENSÉ  BALANCE". Rows grouped into labelled bands: "CE QUI RENTRE" on a very faint carbon wash, "DÉPENSES PRÉVUES" and "DÉPENSES NON PRÉVUES" on a faint red wash, "PAS ENCORE RANGÉ", then two heavy total rows on a darker carbon wash reading "TOTAL DU MOIS" and "TOTAL DÉPASSEMENT". Every number monospace, tabular, right-aligned, format "1 830,20 €". Three or four numbers red (#b31d25). One row carries a small solid black pill chip with tiny white uppercase text "DÉPASSEMENT".

VISUAL WORLD, fixed and non-negotiable: absolutely no rounded corners anywhere; panel corners are cut at 45 degrees. No drop shadows, no gradients, no glass, no glow. Depth comes only from 1px hairline rules and flat tonal washes. Palette strictly: warm concrete grey ground (#e6e3df) with faint concrete grain, lighter plate, near-black carbon, mid grey #6b6966 for labels, and exactly one accent, a signal red #d7262e, used only for negative amounts and overspend marks. No green, no amber, no blue. Typography: condensed grotesque sans for names and headings, monospace for every number and every tiny uppercase label. No charts, no pie graphs, no gauges, no sparklines, no illustrations, no icons beyond thin line arrows and chevrons. Matte, precise, engineering-drawing calm.
